measurementNotes: Direct fixtures deploy production OrderRouter. Request construction, config hash read, oracle-data creation, and vm.prank are outside the measured gasleft interval.
Fixture opening and zero-free withdrawal use public lifecycle calls in setUp. Execute fixtures also commit the close during setUp.
All protocol contract accounts and storage slots are cooled immediately before each measured call.
Gasleft deltas are gross EVM call consumption, before transaction refunds; they exclude intrinsic transaction gas, data publication charges, and real oracle service/update fees.

Direct scenarios use one LONG position: size 10000e18, 250e6 requested margin, flat 1e8 execution price, 500 bps base carry, 0.0005e18 VPI factor, a 30 second interval before close commitment, and configured 0.2 USDC standard close bounty.
Existing GasProfile numbers are a distinct warm fixture with a Legacy test adapter; only compare within the same named fixture, not against direct cold call absolute gas.
